steps.title: Prepare 1% TCA solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g of trichloroacetic acid (TCA) in enough molecular‑grade (mQ) water to make a final volume of 100 mL, yielding a 1 % (w/v) TCA solution.

steps.title: Trypsinize cells and resuspend in PBS
steps.instruction: Treat the cultured cells with trypsin, collect the detached cells, and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Add cold TCA to cell suspension
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of the prepared 1 % cold TCA to each 1 mL cell suspension sample.

steps.title: Vortex and incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Vortex the TCA‑treated samples briefly, then place them on ice for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 12,000 g for 10 minutes and collect the supernatant for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Prepare 100 mM DTT stock (first use only)
steps.instruction: Add 1.62 mL of mQ water to the bottle containing 25 mg dithiothreitol (DTT) to make a 100 mM DTT stock; aliquot into ten 160 µL portions, store frozen at ≤20 °C, and keep thawed aliquots on ice or at 4 °C. Stock is stable for 6 months–1 year.

steps.title: Make 1X Reaction Buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 50 µL of 20X Reaction Buffer with 950 µL of mQ water to obtain 1 mL of 1X Reaction Buffer.

steps.title: Prepare 10 mM luciferin solution
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the 1X Reaction Buffer to one vial of luciferin (blue cap) to make 1 mL of 10 mM luciferin solution; protect from light, store at ≤20 °C, and divide into 250 µL aliquots.

steps.title: Prepare 10 mL Standard Reaction Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 10 mL of Standard Reaction Solution (sufficient for one microplate); gently invert to mix (do not vortex), keep protected from light, and store at 2–6 °C in the dark for up to several days (sensitivity declines over time).

steps.title: Prepare 100 µM ATP stock
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of a 5 mM ATP standard solution to 49 µL of mQ water, yielding 50 µL of 100 µM ATP stock.

steps.title: Create ATP standard dilution series
steps.instruction: Prepare a series of 10X diluted ATP standards as follows:

substeps.instruction: 10 µM 10X: add 10 µL of 100 µM stock to 90 µL mQ water.
1 µM 10X: add 10 µL of the 10 µM solution to 90 µL mQ water.
0.5 µM 10X: add 50 µL of the 1 µM solution to 50 µL mQ water.
0.25 µM 10X: add 50 µL of the 0.5 µM solution to 50 µL mQ water.
0.1 µM 10X: add 40 µL of the 0.25 µM solution to 60 µL mQ water.
0.05 µM 10X: add 50 µL of the 0.1 µM solution to 50 µL mQ water.
0.025 µM 10X: add 50 µL of the 0.05 µM solution to 50 µL mQ water.

steps.title: Add blank wells to microplate
steps.instruction: Dispense two to three duplicate wells of Standard Reaction Solution alone into the microplate to serve as blanks for background luminescence.

steps.title: Add ATP standard dilutions to microplate
steps.instruction: For each 1X ATP standard dilution, add 10 µL of the dilution and 90 µL of Standard Reaction Solution to the microplate, using two to three duplicates per dilution.

steps.title: Add sample dilutions to microplate
steps.instruction: Prepare serialized dilutions of the extracted sample, then add 10 µL of each diluted sample and 90 µL of Standard Reaction Solution to the microplate (this also creates a 1:10 dilution on the plate).

steps.title: Incubate plate before luminescence reading
steps.instruction: Incubate the microplate for 10–15 minutes at room temperature, keeping it protected from light, before measuring luminescence.
